CustomField.description: Calculate the number of payments expected to be made until TODAY()
CustomField.formula: IF(SM_Requires_AC_Payment__c, IF(ISPICKVAL(SM_Way_of_AC_Payment__c, "One payment") ,IF(SM_AC_start_date__c<=TODAY(),1,0) ,IF( SM_AC_Split_Date__c<=TODAY() ,2 ,IF( SM_AC_start_date__c<=TODAY() ,1 ,0 ) ) ) ,0 ) + IF(Contract_Calculated_RC_Start_Date__c<=TODAY(), IF(Contract_End_Date_Calculated__c<=TODAY() ,(YEAR(Contract_End_Date_Calculated__c)-YEAR(Contract_Calculated_RC_Start_Date__c))*12 + MONTH(Contract_End_Date_Calculated__c)- MONTH(Contract_Calculated_RC_Start_Date__c) ,(YEAR(TODAY())-YEAR(Contract_Calculated_RC_Start_Date__c))*12 + MONTH(TODAY())- MONTH(Contract_Calculated_RC_Start_Date__c) ) ,0 )
CustomField.label: Count Expected Pymnts Today
